title: Genesee Theater

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Nestled near the shore of Lake Michigan, The Genesee Theatre is Lake County’s premier setting for weddings, banquets, corporate meetings, community events, private functions and much more. With a combination of majestic beauty, unique spaces and award-winning staff, The Genesee is your place for a memorable event. Our seven unique lounges are ready to accommodate any event from showers, corporate outings and cocktail parties, to business meetings, trainings and seminars. Private events in our beautiful lounges become even more memorable when coupled with tickets to an amazing show. Might we suggest a pre-show cocktail hour on the sunset backdrop of the Marquee

services.name: World Ballet Company: Swan Lake
services.desc: The World’s MOST Iconic Ballet - With a LIVE Orchestra! The legendary tale of Swan Lake takes flight in a breathtaking production from World Ballet Company, as fate and magic entwine in a timeless battle between good and evil.
